meta_description: ML Tree Services in Leeds. Expert tree surgery, felling, and pruning from experienced arborists. Same-day quotes available. Call 07837 498926.
hero_subhead: Overgrown trees damaging your property? We fell, prune, and remove safely with full insurance and disposal included.
services_heading: Tree Surgery & Arborist Services Across Leeds
services_subhead: From routine pruning and hedge cutting to complete tree felling and stump removal, we handle every aspect of tree care with safety and expertise.

services.title: Tree Felling & Removal
services.desc: Safe, efficient felling of hazardous or unwanted trees. We manage everything from assessment through to debris removal and site clearance.

services.title: Tree Pruning & Trimming
services.desc: Crown reduction, deadwood removal, and formative pruning to improve tree health and reduce overgrowth near buildings and services.

services.title: Emergency Storm Damage
services.desc: Urgent response to fallen or damaged trees blocking access or threatening safety. We'll stabilise and remove debris quickly.

services.title: Stump Grinding & Removal
services.desc: Complete stump extraction or grinding below ground level, leaving your garden clear and ready for replanting or building work.

services.title: Hedge Cutting & Maintenance
services.desc: Regular hedge trimming, overgrown hedge restoration, and seasonal maintenance to keep boundaries neat and healthy.

services.title: Tree Health Assessments
services.desc: Professional inspection and advice on diseased, unstable, or poorly positioned trees. We'll recommend the best course of action.

about_pullquote: We treat every tree and every garden like it's our own responsibility.
about_para_1: ML Tree Services has been caring for Leeds properties for over 15 years. We started because we saw too many trees cut down badly or left to become a liability. Our team hold full arborist qualifications and we operate to strict health and safety standards on every job, no matter the size.
about_para_2: Our customers trust us because we're honest about what trees need and we never oversell work. We're fully insured, carry all our own equipment, and leave every garden cleaner than we found it. Whether you've got a veteran oak that needs careful pruning or a dangerous ash that has to come down, we'll give you a fair price and get it done right.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a massive conifer taking over half the garden. Got a quote within hours, price was fair, and the lads turned up on time and made a proper job of it. The garden looks brilliant now. Would use again for sure.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Storm brought down a large branch into our fence. Rang ML early morning and they were here the same day. Professional, tidy, and they cleared everything away. Really impressed. Highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Rebecca M.

reviews.text: Been overdue getting our hedges done for ages. Finally bit the bullet and called these lads. Turned up with all the right kit, got it finished in one afternoon, and charged exactly what they said. No mess left behind either. Top service.
reviews.author: Michael J.
